ambiguidades_e_leituras: dp_entre_celulas in the decision criterion 'ratio dp_sorteios/dp_entre_celulas < 1 in >= 12 of the 16 cells': implemented with two readings of the denominator (sd across the 16 means of the joint K-fold itself; sd across the 16 means of the 2.1 hold-out = T.dp_entre_medias = 2.18 dB). Separate counts.
Threshold '< 1/4 of the hold-out (< 2.0 dB)': 0.25 x T.dp_sorteio = 2.004 dB; the text writes 2.0. Both reported (fields REFORCA_(ii)).

'sd across split draws >= 1/2 of the hold-out in >= 8 cells': hold-out read (a) per cell (sd of the cell's own hold-out, b = 2, constant/valid) and (b) as the mean over the 16 cells (T.dp_sorteio). Counts reported separately.

mu_U (domain mean per cell): R2_resumo.json only contains the 4 Q1 cells; mu_U for the 16 cells recomputed from the tensor with the SAME recipe as R2 (single calibration of the seed 42 partition: training 92 blocks without trimming; e_i over the whole domain; checked against R2 on the 4 Q1 cells). Since the K-fold predictor varies by fold, the bias b = 2 minus b = 0 on the same split draw is also reported (b = 0 scores the whole domain once with the predictor of each fold).

Reference hold-out for populations/predictors other than constant/valid/b=2: recomputed from the partial files (b = 2: fase2/_v3_2.1_3.1_parcial_16x60rnd.json; b = 0: fase4/R1_b0_por_sorteio.json), split draws without any valid node (value None) excluded, same convention as 2.1/R1.

sd (ddof = 1) per cell: np.std; when the 60 values are identical the sd is set to exactly 0.0 (np.std of identical values returned up to 1.07e-14 due to rounding of the mean in the 1st pass, with an earlier script sha; that pass was discarded and everything was rerun with the final sha).

Err_conjunto sums the per-fold losses with np.sum (pairwise) and totals them with math.fsum; for the constant at b = 0 the per-fold sum is checked against math.fsum (field controle_b0_constante_fsum).
Calibrated FSPL (b): reported alongside, without a decision rule (the decision criterion does not define one).
